topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I stumbled upon it, a crumpled piece of paper tucked away in a drawer I rarely explore. It’s not like I was snooping, but there it was—her bucket list. The handwriting, unmistakably hers, listed things I never thought she'd dream of: skydiving, visiting Iceland, learning to paint. I can’t help but wonder why she never mentioned these to me. Maybe I’m not the person she wants to experience her dreams with. I feel the urge to change that, to cross off every item with her, but how do I begin when I don’t even know how to start the conversation? The list sits on the table, a silent reminder of everything between us that’s unspoken and perhaps, unbridgeable.
